commitResults.messageTitle: Add date and time support for deadlines and events
commitResults.messageBody:
- Store task dates as LocalDateTime
- Validate and format user-provided dates
- Persist dates in a consistent format
- Update UI tests for date/time commands

Move standard input handling and all command presentation responsibilities out of Shai into a dedicated Ui class. Keep command dispatch, validation, task mutation, and persistence behavior unchanged while establishing the first class boundary toward the target design.

Move task collection ownership and basic list operations out of Shai into TaskList. Construct the container from loaded tasks, use it for command mutations and display, and provide a defensive copy for the existing Storage API while preserving command behavior.

Move command recognition, argument validation, task-index validation, and date parsing out of Shai into Parser. Return structured parsed commands so Shai focuses on dispatching valid operations while preserving all existing user-facing behavior.

Configure Storage with its task-file path, return TaskList instances from loadTasks, and accept TaskList instances when saving. Remove static file state and the raw-list conversion from Shai while preserving atomic writes and existing user-facing behavior.

Move UI, parser, storage, and task-list ownership into Shai fields initialized by its constructor. Add run as the application loop and keep main as a small default-file launcher, matching the target object-oriented structure without changing CLI behavior.

Add the abstract Command execution contract and concrete ExitCommand, then update Parser to return executable commands. Move the remaining command behavior behind a temporary parsed-command adapter so Shai can run commands through execute and isExit without changing CLI behavior.

Document the required indentation for case and default labels in project instructions and align the parser switch accordingly. Preserve the arrow-form switch and explicit fallthrough guidance while keeping runtime behavior unchanged.
Add a concrete ListCommand and have Parser return it directly for list input. Remove listing from the temporary parsed-command adapter while preserving output and all existing command behavior.

Add a concrete DeleteCommand that removes the selected task, displays the deletion response, and persists the updated TaskList. Have Parser construct it after validating the requested task index, leaving the temporary adapter focused on the remaining commands.

Add concrete MarkCommand and UnmarkCommand implementations for task-status mutations, UI feedback, and persistence. Have Parser construct these commands after task-index validation and remove both behaviors from the temporary adapter.

Add a shared AddCommand for ToDo, Deadline, and Event tasks, and have Parser construct it after validating each command. Remove the temporary parsed-command adapter so every supported command now has a concrete executable Command implementation.
Separate tasks, commands, parsing, storage, UI, and exceptions while keeping src/main/java as the source root. Update the UI test plan for the packaged entry point.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add JUnit coverage and configure Shai testing
Parser and Storage: Apply Java style fixes
commitResults.messageBody:
Parser contains an overlong event validation message, and Storage
imports are not ordered consistently.

Apply line wrapping and reorder standard-library imports to follow the
project Java coding standard without changing behavior.

commitResults.messageTitle: Java standard: Add project coding skill
commitResults.messageBody:
Java code lacks an explicit project-level reference to the SE-EDU
coding conventions, making future changes harder to review consistently.

Add the coding-standard skill and require it in AGENTS.md so
production and test code follow the same naming, layout, statement,
import, and Javadoc rules.

commitResults.messageTitle: Git standard: Add project commit rules
commitResults.messageBody:
The project lacks dedicated guidance for consistent commit subjects,
bodies, or branch names.

Add the Git-standard skill and require it in AGENTS.md so future
commits describe WHAT changed and WHY, use valid subject formatting,
and avoid unrelated staged files.

commitResults.messageTitle: Find command: Search tasks by keyword
commitResults.messageBody:
Users cannot search the task list by text, so relevant tasks require
manual inspection.

Add a case-insensitive substring search command with filtered task-list
results, user-facing output, parser validation, and regression tests.
Document the new command in the CLI test plan.

Ignore the project-local Gradle user home used for repeatable builds.

Wire Gradle to Checkstyle 14.1.0 and add the SE-EDU-compatible
configuration and suppressions.

Fix the existing import-order and line-wrapping violations so the
new checks pass for production and test code.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add JavaFX GUI resources and separate demo model
Connect JavaFX GUI to Shai command engine
commitResults.messageBody:
WHAT: Add programmatic command responses, configurable UI output, and GUI
integration with the real Shai class. Remove the temporary GuiShai stub and
add coverage for GUI command processing.

WHY: Allow the CLI and GUI to reuse the same parser, commands, task state,
and storage logic.

Add a packaged GUI that reuses Shai's command-processing logic and
displays conversations as dialog bubbles.

Add circular avatars, show Shai's greeting on launch, and close the
window after the bye command.

commitResults.messageTitle: Storage: Join task fields with varargs
commitResults.messageBody:
Task records contain different numbers of fields depending on their type.
Use a varargs helper to format ToDo, Deadline, and Event records consistently
and remove repetitive string concatenation.
